mission: Acquire NEW legally-usable pickleball footage the repo has never seen (per-item rights verification; unknown rights = quarantine), run the full available Linux pipeline on each new clip, record verdicts, and mine disagreements/failures as fresh-data evidence.
method: YouTube CC-filtered search via yt-dlp; per-video license field read from the watch-page metadata (yt-dlp page parse, 2026-08-29); prioritized uploaders NOT already in datasets/pickleball/registry.json (5 of 6 accepted clips are from never-before-used channels); 60s video-only segments re-encoded (libx264 crf20, audio stripped); full-clip contact-sheet frame screening for third-party/broadcast watermarks before acceptance; append-only registry registration; then pose-free Linux pipeline replay (capture-envelope + OOD pre-analysis gate) per clip, plus a 10s-window probe of two clips to mine content-level gate misses.

diversityAdded: first vertical (1080x1920) CC BY gameplay clip in the fresh pool
covered-court singles with uploader score-overlay graphic and full-frame face close-ups (50 fps)
indoor club show court with spectators (purple/blue surface)
indoor gym 4.5 amateur tournament (multi-court, flag backdrop)
outdoor desert-court windy instructional segment (60 fps)
2014-era outdoor tournament final shot through a fence (oldest-vintage footage in the pool)
datasetScope.grouping: All 6 clips registered as role=fresh_candidate, labelBlind=true in datasets/pickleball/registry.json (append-only); excluded from corpus/splits/training until a future freeze; no labels created.

holdoutStatement: Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were never read, listed, opened, or referenced by this workstream. All measurements below are on the 6 newly acquired clips only.

configuration.rightsPolicy: Only clips whose YouTube watch page declares 'Creative Commons Attribution license (reuse allowed)' (CC BY 3.0) accepted; video stream only (no audio) to avoid embedded-music risk; broadcast/league re-uploads treated as license-laundering risk and skipped; frame screening for third-party watermarks on every accepted clip; uploader-authority residual caveat recorded per item (channel-context assessment, not rights-holder confirmation)
pipelineStagesRun: capture-envelope: measureClip -> evaluateCaptureEnvelope (thresholds v0.1, UNVALIDATED per e15/f18 preserved negatives; statuses are threshold classifications, not validated capture-quality truth)
OOD pre-analysis gate: extractFrameStats -> evaluateFrameAnalyzability -> preAnalysisGate({frame, pose: null, poseQuality: null})
configuration.stagesNotRunnable: Apple-Vision pose extraction, strict cascade, and all pose-conditioned stages are macOS-only; pose-derived envelope dimensions are NOT_MEASURED and pose-conditioned gate signals are notEvaluated by construction. No cascade numbers are claimed.

wholeClip.envelopeOverallSupported: 6/6 clips (all 8 video-derived dimensions SUPPORTED on every clip; 2 pose-derived dimensions NOT_MEASURED on every clip)
wholeClip.oodGatePassed: 6/6 clips (frameAnalyzable=true, gateOk=true, frameReasons=[] on all 6; camera_motion, scene_cuts, exposure_flicker, playback_speed, pose_presence, pose_capture_quality notEvaluated on all 6)

windowProbe.description: 10s windows (6 per clip) of yt-tuKiznvDJ4E and yt-jkiAWFrdc-g. Visual screening of a mid-window frame per window (montage): at least 2 of 6 yt-tuKiznvDJ4E windows are dominated by full-frame face close-ups with no court or play visible, and at least 4 of 6 yt-jkiAWFrdc-g windows are talking-to-camera instructional content rather than rally play. All 12 windows pass the pose-free gate with zero frameReasons.

findings: FRESH-DATA GATE GAP (confirms e11's disclosed limitation on genuinely new footage): the pose-free OOD gate passes full-frame face close-up windows (no court, no play) and talking-head instructional windows with zero reasons - 12/12 windows passed including >=2 face-only and >=4 non-play windows. Rejecting these requires the pose-conditioned checks (macOS) or content-level signals that do not exist yet.

Envelope thresholds v0.1 classify all 6 new clips SUPPORTED on every video-derived dimension, including a vertical 1080x1920 clip and a 2014-era re-encode. Given e15/f18 could not validate these thresholds, 6/6 SUPPORTED is a threshold classification only; it does add 6 fresh in-envelope points showing the thresholds are not rejecting ordinary new footage.

Supply: YouTube CC BY remains the only productive lawful source found; 5 new never-before-used uploaders were still discoverable, so the CC BY pool is NOT yet exhausted (contrary to a possible reading of 'exhausted' in earlier boards, which applied to DVIDS/Commons/NARA). Broadcast/league re-uploads with CC flags remain the dominant contamination risk and were skipped.

One download defect: the initial 1080-height-capped format selection of the vertical video CWqy7OtTpe4 silently returned a 360x640 stream; corrected by re-downloading the full vertical stream. Recorded as an acquisition-tooling footgun for vertical sources.
verdictRationale: Mission satisfied with honest evidence: 6 genuinely new rights-verified clips (5 from never-before-used uploaders) acquired, registered append-only and label-blind; every Linux-runnable pipeline stage replayed on all 6 with recorded verdicts (6/6 envelope SUPPORTED with unvalidated-thresholds caveat, 6/6 gate pass); and the window probe produced a concrete fresh-data finding (12/12 non-play/face-close-up windows pass the pose-free gate). No thresholds were changed, no labels created, no held-out case touched, no Mac/iPhone numbers fabricated. The gate-gap finding is disclosed as confirmation of a known limitation, now evidenced on footage the repo had never seen.
